utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Good morning to everybody in and around the courtroom. Mr. Registrar, will you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honours. Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning to everyone in and around the courtroom. This is case number IT-04-81-T, the Prosecutor versus Momcilo Perisic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. Could we have the appearances for the day. Starting with the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. HARMON
utterances.text: Yes, good morning, Your Honours, counsel, everyone in the courtroom. Mark Harmon, Salvatore Cannata, and Inger de Ru for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much. For the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning to everyone in the courtroom. Mr. Perisic is today represented by Milos Androvic, Eric Tully, Tina Drolec, Daniela Tasic, Gregor Guy-Smith, and Novak Lukic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. May the Chamber please move into closed session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We are back in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you. Do you have anything to say, Mr. Guy-Smith?

utterances.speaker: MR. GUY-SMITH
utterances.text: Yes, I do, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. GUY-SMITH
utterances.text: I'm wondering if before today's session is over we can get some clarification with regard to when we are recommencing after the break. And the reason I'm asking that question is because the witness who we had been informed would be the next witness apparently is not going to be available, and I don't know whether or not that changes the schedule or not; and with regard to anybody's preparation and travel plans, it does make some difference to us. So if we could get some information from the Prosecution, we'd appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: From the Prosecution, as to when we are recommencing?

utterances.speaker: MR. GUY-SMITH
utterances.text: When their next witness is going to be available because it may directly affect when we are going to recommence. There may be a matter for the Chamber's consideration in that regard.

utterances.speaker: MR. HARMON
utterances.text: Your Honour, I need to consult with Mr. Thomas. I will consult with him immediately after court and I will advise the Court and counsel of the state of play.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Right. Now, I can tell you that recess ends on the 16th of August. This matter is going to be postponed to the 17th of August. Court adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Monday, the 17th day of August, 2009, at 2.15 p.m. 18 19 20 21 22 23 24 25

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 10.12 a.m.
